metadata.project: Cloud-Native 5G Standalone Core — Final Year Engineering Project
metadata.data_source: AWS Cost Explorer + manual billing verification
metadata.note: All figures are REAL charges from AWS billing console. Estimates are clearly labelled.

total_actual_spend.note: Actual charge from AWS billing dashboard for period 2026-05-21 to 2026-05-28

eks_control_plane.notes: EKS control plane charges at $0.10/hr flat regardless of node count. Preserved during shutdown.

ec2_nodes.notes: Nodes were active for approximately 3 full days; scaled to 0 remainder of period

nat_gateways.description: NAT Gateway × 2 (one per AZ for HA — us-east-1a, us-east-1b)
nat_gateways.notes: Most expensive per-hour resource relative to value. Deleted during Phase 8 shutdown.

cloudwatch_container_insights.description: Amazon CloudWatch — Container Insights metrics + logs
cloudwatch_container_insights.notes: One-time spike from Container Insights addon during Phase 8.5–8.7. Addon deleted in shutdown. Log groups also deleted.

alb_load_balancer.description: Application Load Balancer (Grafana ingress via AWS LB Controller)
alb_load_balancer.notes: ALB provisioned by kubernetes.io/ingress.class: alb annotation. Deleted during shutdown.

sagemaker_endpoints.description: SageMaker real-time inference endpoints × 3 (Phase 8 ML pipeline)
sagemaker_endpoints.notes: Endpoints were live for ~2 hours each during Phase 8 testing. Deleted after testing.

ecr_storage.description: Amazon ECR — container image storage (17 repositories)
ecr_storage.notes: Includes open5gs images (~82MB each), closed-loop v3.1.0 (82.5MB), ueransim images. Storage preserved during shutdown.

s3_and_amp.description: Amazon S3 (model artefacts + AI reports) + Amazon Managed Prometheus

s3.notes: ML model artefacts (4.5MB) + Bedrock AI-generated reports (20 files). Negligible cost.

amp.notes: Prometheus metrics ingestion and query charges

bedrock_ai.description: Amazon Bedrock — Claude Sonnet 4.6 / Haiku 4.5 / Nova Lite / Nova Micro (4-tier cascade)
bedrock_ai.notes: All invocations during Phase 8.7 testing hit daily free-tier token quota limits. Marketplace agreements created but quota exhausted before successful paid invocations. Effectively $0 for this deployment phase.

data_transfer.description: AWS data transfer (outbound to internet + cross-AZ)
data_transfer.notes: Includes kubectl API calls, ECR image pulls, pod-to-pod cross-AZ traffic

sns_alerts.description: Amazon SNS — alert notifications to nigelkadzinga91@gmail.com
sns_alerts.notes: Negligible. SNS email notifications for anomaly alerts.

post_shutdown_daily_costs.notes: EKS control plane is only remaining billable resource after shutdown. All compute deleted.

minimum_config.description: Nodes scaled to 0 when idle, 4h active/day

full_production_24_7.description: 3 nodes 24/7 with autoscaling, CloudWatch, full monitoring
